decisions.reason: As a niche men's care line with several variants, Product A likely faces more uncertain demand and higher resource use than the firm's core ranges, so if results are merely average in a growing market the firm would be inclined to reallocate resources to established products or new development.

Product B is a close extension of an existing facial-care series and fits the firm's core natural-cosmetics capabilities, so even with limited evidence the firm would likely keep it unless performance clearly falls below aspiration.
